title: Improved Global Landscape Guarantees for Low-rank Factorization in Synchronization
summary: The orthogonal group synchronization problem, which aims to recover a set of $d \times d$ orthogonal matrices from their pairwise noisy products, plays a fundamental role in signal processing, computer vision, and network analysis. In recent years, numerous optimization techniques, such as semidefinite relaxation (SDR) and low-rank (Burer-Monteiro) factorization, have been proposed to address this problem and their theoretical guarantees have been extensively studied.
